title: American Beauty
about: A suburban dad in a midlife crisis quits his job, buys his dream car and takes a job at a burger drive-thru.
cue: Serve the burgers when Carolyn and Buddy pull up at the drive-thru.
faces: Open 5 pm till late, seven nights.

Crisp battered asparagus and lemon mayo.How to make it2 bunches of asparagus, trimmed100g plain flour2 tbsp cornflour180ml ice-cold soda water750ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise1 lemon, zested and juicedStir the mayonnaise with the lemon zest and a squeeze of juice.Whisk the flour, cornflour, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a lumpy batter.Dip the spears and fry in oil at 180°C in batches until pale gold and crisp.Salt and serve straight away with the lemon mayo.Smiley sauce onion ringsLester offers Carolyn Smiley sauce.
